panels.description: After the contest, unnamed townspeople use GODARAZ as a third place: simplified figures at the counter with chai and kachori, children and workers at lanes. No face is recognizable. Moti’s five-dog pack rests in shade outside. Keep upper-left interior space clear.
Billi sits in the other ball return while Duda grips lane 3. The mural, crooked lane and working chain share the frame. Keep the upper third clear.
Guddu reaches toward a worker adjusting the counter, then stops and leaves the adjustment in place. Keep space above his hand and face open.

Outside, Saand passes beneath his unfinished self-shaped fountain and looks back toward GODARAZ. Through the open entrance, Guddu looks at the lane. Keep exterior and interior balloon areas separated.
